{{Top|leg}}
The '''Senate Building security center''' was a room of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The room contained controls for all of the Senate's security systems and gave access to footage from all of the [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]] located throughout the building.
